basic_info.description: Prime Presidio Heights location with Golden Gate Bridge Views. Incredible  House like 2 level penthouse condominium with expansive private roof deck. 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths, formal living room & dining room with fireplaces. Classic Edwardian detail throughout. 1 car private garage with interior access. Best block in Presdio Heights!
